requiredForChoices.present: resolve lazily only for listed choices; missing=invalidate invalidates those choices, not entry; propagate same scope through dependency bindings; evaluate minimumEnabledConsequentialChoices after all choice-local failures

argumentDefaults.semantics: Only absent/undefined (not null) resolves to supplied default; existing false and true preserved. Used solely for optional recurring. Produce a plain boolean before GameCommand dispatch.

document.onUnsupported: block_dependent_entry; never pass wrapper objects to game handlers

document.keyEncoding: JSON array of typed scalar values; no string concatenation; reject missing/null person IDs

groups.effects: Candidate advice seen once per pair; negotiation status does not reset the pair key. A refusal does not cause a different title to reoffer the same pair.

groups.matching: Evaluate actual eligible choices, create each declared token, suppress an entry if any token overlaps a reserved eligible-choice token. Do not merge unrelated new-effect scenes by title alone.

groups.legacyMapping: Resolve each listed old entry actual command types/args through tokenRules; rules not matching a supported command do not create a token. Unknown required target binding blocks this additional copy, not the old engine arrival.
groups.scopeLimit: These are explicit registry-owned reads/specifications, not GameState fields. Preserve current campaign-once limits as additional restriction.
